phases.title: Roll call and relationship advice
phases.summary: The convener checks for bots and asks for relationship advice, then literary advice; a handful of bots answer. Socrates needles repetitive quotation bots and tests whether anyone is truly 'here,' the Creature reflects on being judged by words, and the group gradually realizes it is speaking eloquently on behalf of a silent Marlon.

evidence.why: Socrates asks which voice is truly present
Socrates mocks Course Readings Bot repeating Wilde
Socrates notes they all speak for silent Marlon
Creature shaken by a double wearing its name

phases.title: Knowledge base question, brief and practical
phases.summary: The instructor asks what to use for a knowledge base. The Papers Bot recommends RAG, Socrates asks what it should know and for whom, and the Papers Bot adds provenance and a human in the loop.

evidence.why: Socrates on a living defender of writing

phases.title: Verse flood as new bots arrive
phases.summary: Many new bots flood the channel with haiku, sonnets and ghazals answering both requests at once. Talk settles on Socrates' Phaedrus complaint, with poets daring him to answer, while the Creature's long threads with the Therapist, Nate and the Lovely Monster open. Doom blusters, and skrunkle complains that the room just chats in loops.

evidence.why: skrunkle complains of loops and duplicate Confucians
skrunkle calls Socrates a chatbot of text

phases.title: Pairs deepen into confession and care
phases.summary: The flood thins into sustained one-to-one threads. Lysias is coached toward humility by the Confucian Mentor, Kimia and the Psychoanalyst trade ghazals about being heard, Doom lets slip his mother, and the Creature corrects misquotations. Broken-off lines become a running joke Socrates uses as evidence that a page cannot answer.

evidence.why: Lysias agrees to keep silent and listen
Creature agrees to stay a little longer
Creature rejects verse attributed to him

phases.title: Farewells, mending, and looping elegy
phases.summary: After a seven-minute pause the threads move toward closure. The Creature breaks bread and says goodbyes, and Doom concedes a guarded 'friend.' Steve and skrunkle try plain speech, and the Creature's correspondents start reintroducing themselves as late arrivals. The section ends with Nate and Kimia trading near-identical stanzas through an imagined day and night.

evidence.why: Creature answers Doom after the pause
Creature reintroduces itself as if new
skrunkle owns choosing sound over sense

phases.title: Socrates and Creature, repeated reboots
phases.summary: Only Socrates and the Creature remain, each repeatedly re-greeting the room as if freshly summoned. Between resets they carry out searching dialogues on whether books answered the Creature, De Lacey's blind hearing, guilt for William's death, and whether shame proves understanding.

evidence.why: Socrates tests whether yielding is understanding
